core_categories: B2B Marketplace; Industrial Machinery; Construction Materials; Packaging Supplies; Consumer Electronics; Apparel; Chemicals; Pharmaceuticals; Medical Supplies
specialty_focus: IndiaMART is India's largest online B2B marketplace, connecting business buyers with wholesale suppliers, manufacturers, and exporters. It focuses on bulk orders, commercial procurement, and trade lead generation across over 50 industries, hosting tens of millions of items in over 100,000 categories. It does not specialize in wearable medical devices but includes medical supplies among its categories.
